title: Blind / Unverified Health Probes
pattern: Returning HTTP 200 / "OK" strictly because the server process is alive, without validating key dependencies or local resource pools.
why_bad: The process is reported as healthy even when its local database connection pool is completely exhausted or its filesystems are write-blocked. The load balancer continues to send real user traffic to a "zombie" instance [247, 672, 683].
detection: A liveness or readiness route handler that returns a static successful payload without evaluating any external resource handles.
fix: Incorporate lightweight connectivity checks for critical, non-soft dependencies (such as local DB pools or storage access) directly into the readiness probe pathway.
